properties.site-address: Land And Buildings North West Of Walwick
properties.notes: Permission has now been granted for conversion of vacant agricultural buildings at a rural farmstead to 5 dwellings (18/00503/FUL). Development has not yet commenced but is expected to be completed within 5 years. The site lies adjacent to Hadrian's Wall and an acceptable scheme will successfully address this relationship, without any adverse impact on heritage assets.
